description: This source file defines the class GeoDistanceFilterProvider, which implements spatial filtering logic for geo-distance queries within the OrchardCore search module using Lucene.Net and Spatial4n libraries.

classes.name: GeoDistanceFilterProvider
classes.description: Partial class implementing spatial geo-distance filtering logic for Lucene queries.

methods.name: CreateFilteredQuery
methods.description: Creates a filtered Lucene query based on geo-distance parameters extracted from JSON filter input.

methods.name: TryParseDistance
methods.description: Parses a distance string with units (e.g., km, mi) into degrees for spatial calculations.

methods.name: TryGetPointFromJToken
methods.description: Extracts a geographic point (latitude and longitude) from various JSON representations.
